summary: Backend-only regression testing for HalloPetra stability fixes (MongoDB timeout, sync interval, throttling). All 13 pytest tests passed. Verified code-level fixes (serverSelectionTimeoutMS=30000, _auto_sync_loop default=1800s, throttling yields present) and runtime API behavior (/api/health, admin login, /api/tasks, all /api/hallopetra/* endpoints including manual /sync-calls). Backend logs confirm 'HalloPetra Auto-Sync-Loop gestartet (Intervall 30 Min)' and zero ServerSelectionTimeoutError occurrences. Manual sync completes in <60s without crashing backend.
critical_code_review_comments: hallopetra.py is 1013 lines — approaching the 700-line threshold; consider splitting into hallopetra_sync.py, hallopetra_contacts.py, hallopetra_routes.py for maintainability.

Auth pattern uses token as query param (?token=...) across all HalloPetra endpoints — leaks JWTs into access logs (visible in /var/log/supervisor/backend.out.log). Should switch to Authorization: Bearer header.

_auto_sync_loop swallows all exceptions with a broad `except Exception` and only logs a warning — a permanently failing DB call would silently spin every 30 min. Consider exponential backoff on repeated failures.
context_for_next_testing_agent: HalloPetra stability tests live in test_hallopetra_stability_iteration87.py. Reuse as regression whenever hallopetra.py or MongoDB init in server.py changes. Note: manual sync currently returns 200 with created=0 (token configured, no new qualified calls). If test env token is removed, expect 400 'HalloPetra-Token nicht konfiguriert' — test allows both.
